INTRODUCTION

Blank detail specification A blank detail specification is a supplementary document to the Sectional Specification and contains requirements for style and layout and minimum content of detail specifications. Detail specifications not complying with these requirements may not be considered as being in accordance with I E C specifications nor shall they so be described.
